description:
Files:
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.ex
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.html.heex
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/ingress_status_ui.ex
- shared QR component and Storybook

Functional specifications:
Read DESIGN.md and BO component guide. Adapt prior provider card, label, token-free validation intent and safe QR matrix renderer. Use exact connector for all status/retry events. Show sync disabled. Cancel/bound polling and tag generations; clear QR on expiry/disconnect and show real failures. Do not copy old discarded restart error or stale timer handling.
Architecture refinement: Use provider-neutral QR/status/retry components and existing Credentials device-connection UX where compatible. Provider labels and WhatsApp sync policy remain provider-specific; do not hardcode Amarula in shared UI.

Tests before implementation:
- Two configs and selected account
- Expiry
- Retry failure
- Navigation cleanup
- Stale event ignored
- Disabled sync UI
- Exercise shared contract with a minimal fake second provider; keep WhatsApp-specific expectations in provider contract tests

Branches validated:
- create
- edit
- pair
- expire
- retry
- disable
- access denial

Documentation:
- Storybook
- component docs
- operator setup guide

Action reuse assessment:
Reuse Engine persistence and Channels status/retry through NodeRouter. BO owns presentation/timers only; no credentials or connection ownership. Preserve authorization; no new Action. Immediate LiveView/component tests; E2E authoring deferred to explicit human UX gate. Inspect and reuse existing device-connection behavior before adding shared modules; document any missing contract as a prerequisite. No duplicate provider-specific credential store or pairing framework.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

comments.text: Implemented generic DS pairing modal + Storybook; reused safe QR matrix renderer approach and local WhatsApp icon from prior branch, not its lifecycle. Added WhatsApp card and token-free form, exact account selection, bounded generation-tagged polling and cleanup on close/config changes, retry errors, secret-free mode query through NodeRouter. QR omitted from background card health responses. Static component browser previews at /tmp/zaq-pairing-{pairing,connected,expired}.png use dummy non-credential QR. mix q/assets build pass; 246 focused UI/Api/bridge tests pass. Human completed UX review requested asynchronously; no new E2E authored.

title: [zaq-0l7.6] Build shared linked-device pairing UI with WhatsApp entry point
